title: Forecasting Inflation with ARIMA
analytical_question: Can past inflation help produce a transparent baseline inflation forecast?
learning_objectives: Explain why automatic model selection still needs judgement

concepts.name: ARIMA
concepts.plain_english: ARIMA forecasts one variable using its own past values, differencing, and past forecast errors.

concepts.name: Forecast interval
concepts.plain_english: A forecast interval shows a range of plausible outcomes, not a guarantee.

review_questions: Does the forecast react too slowly to shocks?
Could structural breaks make the model unreliable?
